football skins.aioText:
You can purchase football compression skins, base layers, and thermal underlayers from specialized suppliers like [Sports Direct](https://www.sportsdirect.com/football/clothing/base-layer) or [Kitlocker](https://kitlocker.com/collection/football-baselayers/).[[1]](https://www.sportsdirect.com/football/clothing/base-layer)[[2]](https://kitlocker.com/collection/football-baselayers/)

- **Compression Gear:** Brands like Skins (such as the [DNAmic Force shorts](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:48,mid:576462914940217241,imageDocid:13615127293584577338,gpcid:7484879066353226091,headlineOfferDocid:6138444052436181656,catalogid:2640989237527944895,productDocid:13860091857888945954&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiv2-z-t7WXAxVOJkQIHeMzO08Qxa4PegoIAggACAAICxAN) ) and FORZA offer targeted gradient compression to stabilize muscles and improve blood flow.
- **Thermal Underlayers:** Nike ([Dri-FIT Park First Layer](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:48,mid:576462563946376644,imageDocid:11760218496266078580,gpcid:1006774391760869862,headlineOfferDocid:4538842983606439339,catalogid:3123387469566980814,productDocid:15802868785999165155,rds:CSS_PC_1006774391760869862%7CPC_1006774391760869862%7CPROD_CSS_PC_1006774391760869862%7CPROD_PC_1006774391760869862&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiv2-z-t7WXAxVOJkQIHeMzO08Qxa4PegoIAggACAAICxAQ) ), Adidas (Techfit ), and Joma provide long-sleeve tops and tights designed to wick away sweat and regulate body temperature.
- **Goalkeeper Protection:** Brands like Precision make specialized padded base layer trousers and tops for extra impact and pitch-abrasion protection.
- **Pricing:** Standard adult and junior base layers typically range from **£5.00 to £35.00** depending on the brand and multi-buy options.[[1]](https://www.sportsdirect.com/football/clothing/base-layer)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5113714713339250346,catalogid:14176560858537073126,gpcid:18179040846970590098,mid:576462882423893612&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.forza.com/uk/football/football-kits/football-base-layers)[[4]](https://www.directsoccer.co.uk/football-kits/mens-football-kit/base-layers)[[5]](https://kitlocker.com/collection/football-baselayers/)[[6]](https://www.decathlon.co.uk/sports/football/football-base-layers)

If you are looking for specific gear, let me know:

- Are you shopping for **adults or juniors**?
- Do you need **tops, tight shorts, or full-length leggings**?

football skins for juniors.aioText:
Junior football skins (`base layers and compression wear` ) keep young players warm, dry, and comfortable on the pitch.[[1]](https://kitlocker.com/collection/kids-baselayers/)

- **Sports Direct:** Offers a large selection of junior base layer tops, leggings, shorts, and full sets from brands like Sondico, Under Armour, and Adidas, ranging from **£4.00 to £60.00** via [Sports Direct](https://www.sportsdirect.com/kids/clothing/base-layers).
- **Decathlon:** Features kids' thermal shirts, tights, and seamless compression gear starting around **£6.00** via [Decathlon](https://www.decathlon.co.uk/sports/football/kids-thermal-base-layers-tops).
- **FORZA:** Specializes in moisture-control and compression long-sleeve tops engineered for junior match-day kits available through [FORZA](https://www.forza.com/uk/junior-boys-base-layer-long-sleeve-top).
- **Amazon UK:** Carries budget-friendly multi-packs and single-piece compression shirts and thermal skins for ages 2 to 14 via [Amazon UK](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kids-football-skins-boys/s?k=kids+football+skins+boys) , typically priced between **£8.99 and £27.95**.[[1]](https://www.forza.com/uk/junior-boys-base-layer-long-sleeve-top)[[2]](https://www.sportsdirect.com/kids/clothing/base-layers/boys)[[3]](https://www.sportsdirect.com/kids/clothing/base-layers)[[4]](https://www.decathlon.co.uk/sports/football/kids-thermal-base-layers-tops)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14871999879213649845&ibp=oshop)[[6]](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kids-football-skins-boys/s?k=kids+football+skins+boys)[[7]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:3580322272902749357&ibp=oshop)

### Key Features to Look For

- **Moisture-Wicking:** Polyester/elastane blends pull sweat away to keep players from getting cold during breaks.
- **Compression Fit:** A snug 4-way stretch allows complete freedom of movement for running, shooting, and tackling.
- **Color Rules:** Check your junior team or school P.E. guidelines—most clubs require base layers to match the main color of the kit sleeves or shorts (commonly solid black, white, or navy).[[1]](https://www.directsoccer.co.uk/football-kits/kids-football-kit/football-base-layers)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:3580322272902749357&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14871999879213649845&ibp=oshop)

If you'd like to narrow down the options, let me know:

- What **age or size** do you need?
- Are you looking for **just a top, leggings, or a full set**?
- Does the club require a **specific color**?
